meta.title: PDF Merger Online - Free Tool to Combine PDF Files
meta.description: Merge PDF files online. Combine multiple PDFs into one document with our free PDF merger tool.
meta.subtitle: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document effortlessly

form.upload_subtitle: Drag & drop multiple PDFs to merge them into one

content.main_desc: Combine multiple PDF files into one single document. Arrange them in the order you prefer and download the merged file in seconds.
content.feature1_desc: Drag and drop your files to set the order of pages in the final document.
content.feature2_desc: Works on Mac, Windows, and Linux. No software installation needed.
content.feature3_desc: Reliably joins documents without losing formatting or quality.
content.step1_desc: Select two or more PDF files.
content.step2_desc: Drag files to arrange them in your desired sequence.
content.step3_desc: Click the button to download your single PDF.
